sub_graphs.title: EIP-3085: Chain Addition State Machine
sub_graphs.description: Models the state transitions when a dapp requests adding a new chain to the wallet

nodes.label: Wallet Idle
nodes.description: Wallet is in normal operating state, not processing chain addition requests

nodes.label: Chain Addition Request Received
nodes.description: wallet_addEthereumChain RPC request has been received from a dapp

nodes.label: Parse Chain Parameters
nodes.description: Extract chainId, rpcUrls, chainName, nativeCurrency, and other fields from request

nodes.label: Validate Chain ID Format
nodes.description: Verify chainId is a valid hexadecimal string per EIP-155 format

nodes.label: Validate RPC URLs
nodes.description: Check that rpcUrls array is non-empty and all URLs use HTTPS scheme

nodes.label: Verify Chain ID Match
nodes.description: Call eth_chainId on provided RPC endpoints and verify it matches submitted chainId

nodes.label: Validation Failed
nodes.description: One or more validation checks failed, request will be rejected

nodes.label: Validation Passed
nodes.description: All validation checks passed, awaiting user consent

nodes.label: Show User Confirmation Dialog
nodes.description: Display confirmation to user identifying requesting dapp and chain details

nodes.label: Awaiting User Consent
nodes.description: Wallet is waiting for user to approve or reject the chain addition

nodes.label: User Approved Addition
nodes.description: User has explicitly consented to adding the new chain

nodes.label: User Rejected Addition
nodes.description: User has explicitly denied the chain addition request

nodes.label: Add Chain to Wallet Storage
nodes.description: Persist the new chain configuration to wallet's chain registry

nodes.label: Chain Added Successfully
nodes.description: New chain is now available in wallet's chain list

nodes.label: Request Rejected
nodes.description: Chain addition request was rejected, returning error to dapp

edges.label: Query RPC endpoints for chain ID

sub_graphs.title: EIP-3085: Chain Parameter Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models all validation rules that must pass before a chain can be added

nodes.label: Parameters Received
nodes.description: Raw chain parameters have been received from the dapp

nodes.label: Check Chain ID Hexadecimal Format
nodes.description: Verify chainId is a valid hexadecimal string (0x-prefixed)

nodes.label: Check RPC URLs Non-Empty
nodes.description: Verify rpcUrls array exists and is not empty

nodes.label: Check URL Scheme Security
nodes.description: Reject file: and http: schemes, require HTTPS

nodes.label: Check for Duplicate Chain
nodes.description: Verify this chain ID does not already exist in wallet

nodes.label: Query RPC for Chain ID
nodes.description: Call eth_chainId on provided RPC endpoints

nodes.label: Compare Chain IDs
nodes.description: Compare submitted chainId against RPC-reported chain ID

nodes.label: Validate Native Currency Object
nodes.description: If provided, verify nativeCurrency has name, symbol, and non-negative decimals

nodes.label: All Validations Passed
nodes.description: All parameter validation checks have succeeded

nodes.label: Validation Error
nodes.description: One or more validation checks failed

sub_graphs.title: EIP-3085: Trust Boundary for Chain Addition
sub_graphs.description: Models the security boundaries and trust decisions when accepting chain data from external dapps

nodes.label: Untrusted Input Received
nodes.description: Chain parameters received from potentially malicious dapp

nodes.label: Sanitize Chain ID
nodes.description: Use only the submitted chainId for signing, never trust RPC-reported ID

nodes.label: Warn About RPC Exposure
nodes.description: Inform user that activity and IP will be exposed to RPC endpoints

nodes.label: Require Explicit User Consent
nodes.description: Never add chain without explicit user approval

nodes.label: Identify Requesting Party
nodes.description: Display the origin/identity of the dapp requesting chain addition

nodes.label: User Fully Informed
nodes.description: User has been warned about risks and knows who is requesting

nodes.label: Chain Marked as User-Trusted
nodes.description: User has explicitly trusted this chain configuration

edges.label: Dapp sends potentially malicious chain config

external_entities.name: Potentially Malicious Dapp
external_entities.description: External application that may attempt to add malicious chain configuration

sub_graphs.title: EIP-3085: Error Conditions and Responses
sub_graphs.description: Models the various error conditions and how they are communicated back to the dapp

nodes.label: Error: Invalid Chain ID Format
nodes.description: Chain ID is not valid hexadecimal format

nodes.label: Error: Missing RPC URLs
nodes.description: rpcUrls array is empty or missing

nodes.label: Error: Insecure URL Scheme
nodes.description: URL uses http: or file: instead of https:

nodes.label: Error: Chain ID Mismatch
nodes.description: Submitted chainId does not match RPC endpoint response

nodes.label: Error: User Denied Request
nodes.description: User explicitly rejected the chain addition

nodes.label: Error: Invalid Native Currency
nodes.description: nativeCurrency object is malformed or incomplete

nodes.label: Build Error Response
nodes.description: Construct appropriate error object to return to dapp

nodes.label: Error Returned to Dapp
nodes.description: Error response has been sent back to the requesting dapp

ambiguities.text: The specification says rpcUrls is 'conditionally required' but doesn't specify what conditions make it optional
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume rpcUrls is always required for new chain additions. The 'conditional' may refer to updates of existing chains.

ambiguities.text: The specification mentions wallets should 'consider' showing confirmations even for duplicate chains to prevent information leakage, but uses non-normative language
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume security-conscious implementations SHOULD show confirmations for all requests to prevent fingerprinting of wallet chain list.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define specific error codes or error message formats
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume implementations should use standard JSON-RPC error codes and provide descriptive error messages.

implicit_assumptions.description: The wallet trusts that HTTPS RPC endpoints are who they claim to be based on TLS certificate validation
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Man-in-the-middle attacks could cause wallet to accept chains with incorrect configurations or leak user data

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot spoof the origin/identity of the requesting dapp displayed to the user
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Users could be tricked into adding malicious chains by attackers impersonating trusted dapps

implicit_assumptions.description: Users understand the security implications of adding new chains and RPC endpoints
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Users may unknowingly expose their activity to malicious RPC endpoints or accept chains designed for phishing

implicit_assumptions.description: The RPC endpoints provided will respond consistently to eth_chainId queries
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Time-of-check to time-of-use attacks where RPC endpoint returns correct chain ID during validation but operates differently after
